facts.fact: Bayobab Kenya says it has completed a long-distance fibre network from Mombasa to Malaba and Busia, over 1,000 km along the Kenya Railways metre-gauge line, a second route after its 2022 Mombasa-Malaba route.
Bayobab Kenya says internet service providers can use its open access long-distance fibre on the Mombasa-Malaba-Busia route as a high-capacity backbone.
